25 November 2026 – 3 January 2027​
Winter Wonderland in Causeway Bay​
Discover the Christmas charm of Causeway Bay as the Lee Gardens Area becomes a magical Wonderland inspired by the enchanting story of Santa Claus and six adorable elves. Enjoy dazzling light installations, a Christmas market, seasonal workshops and exclusive shopping and dining experiences creating an unforgettable holiday moments for all ages.​
Elf Village and Festive Illuminations​
Watch captivating light shows projected onto the facades along Lan Fong Road and Pak Sha Road, showing elves preparing gifts in Santa’s workshop. Along Hysan Avenue and Yun Ping Road, sparkling illuminations, festive decorations and immersive photo spots create a vibrant winter atmosphere.​
